insights.rule_title: Observed change on an exposure variable
insights.headline: Official exchange rate (INR per US$, period average) — India moved; 7 companies are exposed to USD/INR exchange rate
insights.statement: Official exchange rate (INR per US$, period average) — India moved +9.38 % from 2024 to 2025. It is recorded as a related measure of USD/INR exchange rate, which the graph states reaches Aerisca Airways, Anvaya Bank, Deltrin Refining, Gridwell Power, Kovalent Digital, Skyvara Air and Trakvel Logistics. This names who is exposed; it does not say the change affected them.
